# ankra_api_tokens (Data Source)

Lists the personal API tokens of the provider token's user in the current organisation, revoked ones included. Token values are never part of the listing. The counterpart of `ankra tokens list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_api_tokens" "mine" {}

output "live_token_names" {
  value = [for token in data.ankra_api_tokens.mine.tokens : token.name if !token.revoked]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `tokens` (Attributes List) Personal tokens of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tokens))

<a id="nestedatt--tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tokens`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the token was created.
- `expires_at` (String) When the token expires (UTC, as the platform renders it).
- `id` (String) Identifier of the token.
- `last_used_at` (String) When the token last authenticated; null if never.
- `name` (String) Name of the token.
- `project_id` (String) Project the token is pinned to; null for an organisation-wide token.
- `project_name` (String) Name of the pinned project.
- `revoked` (Boolean) Whether the token is revoked.
- `revoked_at` (String) When the token was revoked; null while it is live.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes the token is restricted to; empty for its user's full authority.
